Works with flour mills in India to fortify wheat flour with iron, folic acid and vitamin B12. GiveWell and Happier Lives Institute published 8 public models of its work; the most recent, from December 2021, puts it at **<span data-figure="headline" data-model="fortify-health-iron-fortification-december-2021">7.2</span> years of healthy life per $1,000**.
